title: CSS Selectors
body:
[[HTML Selector]]
```CSS
elementName {...}
```
[[Class Selector]]
```CSS
className {...}
```
[[ID Selector]]
```HTML
<div id=first>
```

```CSS
#first {...}
```

[[Descendant Selector]]
[[And Selector]]
[[Attribute Selector]]
[[Pseudo Selector]]

---

| Selector | Written | Matches |
|---|---|---|
| [[HTML Selector]] | `p` | every element with that tag name |
| [[Class Selector]] | `.box` | every element with that class |
| [[ID Selector]] | `#first` | the one element with that id |
| [[Descendant Selector]] | `#first p` | right-hand one **inside** left-hand one, any depth |
| [[And Selector]] | `p.box` | both at once, no space |
| [[Attribute Selector]] | `input[type=text]` | on an attribute's presence or value |
| [[Pseudo Selector]] | `a:hover` | on state or position, not on markup |

The space is an operator. `p .box` and `p.box` are different selectors, which is the mistake
worth remembering.

The same strings are what `document.querySelector` and `querySelectorAll` take, so this table
is also the [[DOM]] query language. See [[Selecting Nodes]] and [[CSS]].
